# Notre Dame College Batch 2021 Group A Student Directory

> Public directory of the students of Notre Dame College (NDC), Dhaka, Batch 2021, Group A (Business Studies). Profiles are submitted voluntarily by the students. Site: https://ndc2021a.vercel.app

Individual profile pages live at /students/{id}/{name-slug}. Prefer the pages and files below to crawling the interactive directory.

## Docs

- [Full site as plain text](https://ndc2021a.vercel.app/llms-full.txt): every member with a link to their profile, plus the key facts about the college and the ID system.
- [About Notre Dame College and the student ID guide](https://ndc2021a.vercel.app/about-ndc): history, Room 153 in the Father Tim Building, how the 8-digit roll number works, campus map.
- [Directory home](https://ndc2021a.vercel.app/): search and browse all members.

## Data

- [Dataset (schema.org JSON-LD)](https://ndc2021a.vercel.app/knowledge.json)
- [Person graph (schema.org JSON-LD)](https://ndc2021a.vercel.app/entities.json)
- [Sitemap](https://ndc2021a.vercel.app/sitemap.xml)
